title: dogbed — a document compiler
intro: dogbed is a document compiler, not a CMS: a Knap template plus a JSON object goes in, an HTML document comes out. One static binary, no runtime, no JavaScript, no database, no edit button. k4o does the templating, oliver does the rendering, dogbed joins the halves.
install_p: Grab a static binary from the "releases page":https://github.com/drawmeanelephant/dogbed/releases, or build from source — Zig 0.16.0 and @zig build@ gives you @zig-out/bin/dogbed@.
qs1: Print the verdict starter and keep it — you own it now. Blank lines are shown as ··· — the codeblock filter cannot hold empty lines (fourth finding on the "dogfood page":dogfood.html):
